'''Mahogany''' is a type of [[above ground]] [[tree]]. They are only found in [[tropical]] [[forest|forests]]. Like the overwhelming majority of overland trees, mahogany [[carpenter|wood]] is brown and produces brown products. 

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] mahoganies for their ''loose inflorescences''.

[[File:Khaya senegalensis MS 2037.JPG|thumb|center|300px|Admired for its ''loose inflorescences''.]]
